data.title: 隐德来希 · 帽檐下的笑
data.description: 她按住被风吹动的帽檐，倾身凑到你耳边，说接下来的秘密只告诉离得足够近的人。
data.action: 扶帽倾身，从帽檐下微笑
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: On a high stone terrace overlooking the gilded spires of Victoria at sunset, Entelechia gracefully presses one gloved hand against the brim of her wide felt hat as evening gusts ruffle her dark waves. She leans intimately close to the viewer with a subtle, teasing smirk, while the golden twilight bathes the ornate balustrade and distant chimneys in warm romantic amber.
